entry.description: Offline syntax highlighting for common source code, configuration and markup files, locally or over SSH.

entry.readme:
# Syntax Highlighting · 代码高亮

Offline syntax highlighting for common source, configuration and markup files opened in Tunnelde. One plugin serves local and SSH editor buffers. No language server, network request or code upload is involved.

Install the release ZIP in Tunnelde **0.26.1 or later**, approve Node.js 22+ and `editor.read`, then explicitly start the plugin. Open a supported code file; edits refresh the highlighting automatically. Stopping the plugin or revoking access clears its highlighting. The plugin never changes or saves document text. A compatible development build is required for the experimental syntax protocol.

支持 JS/TS/JSX/TSX、Python、Go、Rust、C/C++、Java、HTML/CSS、Vue/Svelte、JSON、YAML、TOML、Shell、SQL、Markdown 等常用文件，也支持 Dockerfile、Makefile 和 CMakeLists.txt 等文件名。安装后明确启动插件并批准编辑器读取权限；本地和 SSH 已打开文件均可高亮。完整扩展名清单见 Manifest。

TextMate grammars and the Oniguruma WASM engine are bundled. Grammars initialize on demand; semantic token colors come from the active Tunnelde theme. This is syntax highlighting, not type analysis, completion, diagnostics or definition navigation.

Small documents use inline source; larger documents use version-bound, paged visible windows. Multiline strings/comments are accurate when preceding state is available; a cold window starting mid-document is approximate. Work and retained checkpoints are bounded. Unsupported content, exhausted budgets or failures safely leave plain text or partial highlighting.

## Develop and publish

`npm ci --ignore-scripts` → `npm run build` → `npm run verify` → `npm run package`.
Push a matching `vX.Y.Z` tag to publish the ZIP, `SHA256SUMS` and `marketplace.json`. Releases are immutable; the Hub reviews and distributes links to these assets. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for dependency licenses.
